## Brand Authorization
Eternity Products is the authorized importer of Ikonic Professional products imported from India for the Nepal market. Every product sold comes with an official serialized warranty verification card and 13% VAT invoice.

## Delivery & Payment Terms
1. Kathmandu Valley: Free delivery within 24-48 hours.
2. Outside Kathmandu (All 77 Districts): NPR 500 flat delivery fee.
3. Open-Box Inspection: Delivery riders allow customers to open and inspect the box before paying cash.
4. Spa Equipment Deposit: 10% - 15% upfront booking payment via eSewa, Khalti, or Bank Transfer to confirm custom manufacturing and floor delivery.
